name: GR00T N1.6 · SimplerEnv Bridge (WidowX)
meta: Seven WidowX tasks · 200 episodes per task
footnote: Checkpoint nvidia/GR00T-N1.6-bridge on RTX 4070 Ti SUPER; SimplerEnv 8a2d286, 5 vectorised envs, 4 action steps, 300-step cap. Against BF16, paired over the seven tasks: W8A8 −2.8 pp (t(6) = −3.03, p = 0.02 uncorrected; not presented as a significant loss), mean |Δ| 2.8 pp, worst −7.5 (close drawer); W4A4 −1.0 pp (p = 0.89), mean |Δ| 13.6 pp, worst −34.5 (eggplant in basket); W4A4 + o/d INT8 +2.0 pp (p = 0.70), mean |Δ| 10.1 pp, worst −22.0 (eggplant in basket). Holding o_proj and down_proj at INT8 recovers open drawer (81.5 → 92.0) and the basket (58.0 → 70.5). W8A8 close- and open-drawer were re-run in a separate session after GPU-memory contention with the simulator renderers. The BF16 basket cell is as reported by the rollout script (0.9254), not a multiple of 1/200. No TRT BF16 or ModelOpt arm was run on this benchmark.
